steps.description:
1. A Create-text block is used to convert values to text format. It can also join different values into a single text.
  2. By clicking on the blue gear icon on the Create-text block, you can add or remove slots.

  3. Form the following code and test it.

Create a code that produces the same results as shown below.

Hint: Do the practice section

The code below shows a Count Loop.


  1. It counts from one number to another, each time increasing by a step.
  2. "i" is a variable that stores the counting number. It can be found in Variables section when a Count Loop is used.



  3. Its value is being displayed on the LCD. In order to display numbers on the LCD, you need to convert them to text using the Create-text block.
  4. Test the code and observe the display.

Use a Count Loop to display the following numbers one by one:

    6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11
